summary: User login with email and password
description: As a registered shopper I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.
acceptance_criteria: Valid email and password redirects the user to the home page within 3 seconds
Invalid password shows the error 'Invalid email or password' and does not reveal which field is wrong
Account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed attempts

description: As a shopper who forgot my password I want to reset it using an emailed link so that I can regain access.
acceptance_criteria: A reset link is emailed within 60 seconds of a valid request
The reset link expires after 30 minutes and cannot be reused
New password must satisfy the password policy (min 8 chars, 1 upper, 1 digit, 1 special)

description: As a shopper I want to add products to my cart so that I can buy several items in one order.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Add to cart' increments the cart badge by the selected quantity
Quantity above available stock is rejected with the message 'Only N items left'
Cart contents persist after the user logs out and logs back in

description: As a shopper I want to search the catalog by keyword so that I can find products quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Search returns results within 2 seconds for catalogs up to 10,000 products
Search is case-insensitive and tolerates one typo
Zero results shows 'No products found' with three suggested categories

description: As a shopper I want to apply a coupon code at checkout so that I get the advertised discount.
acceptance_criteria: A valid coupon reduces the order total by the coupon percentage and shows the saving
An expired or unknown coupon shows 'Coupon is not valid' and leaves the total unchanged
Only one coupon can be applied per order
Coupons cannot reduce the total below zero

description: As a shopper I want to update my name, phone number and address so that deliveries reach me.
acceptance_criteria: Name, phone and address can be edited and saved with a success toast
Phone number must be 10 digits; otherwise an inline error is shown
Changes are visible on the next page load

summary: Pay for an order with a credit card
description: As a shopper I want to pay with my credit card so that I can complete my purchase securely.
acceptance_criteria: A valid card completes payment and shows an order confirmation number
A declined card shows 'Payment declined' and keeps the cart intact
Card number, expiry and CVV are validated client-side before submission
Double-clicking Pay must not create two charges

description: As a shopper I want to view my past orders so that I can track deliveries and reorder.
acceptance_criteria: Orders are listed newest first with order id, date, total and status
Selecting an order shows its line items and delivery status
A user with no orders sees 'You have no orders yet'
